notes.title: Prickle is Steam Deck Verified
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that Prickle is now officially Steam Deck Verified! This means that you can now enjoy the full Prickle experience on your Steam Deck, with optimized performance and seamless gameplay.

We have been working hard to ensure that Prickle runs smoothly on the Steam Deck, and we are confident that you will have a great time playing it on the go.

Whether you're commuting, traveling, or just relaxing at home, you can now take Prickle with you wherever you go.

So grab your Steam Deck and go get some hoglets back home, today.

notes.title: Prickle is a wholesome Sokoban-style puzzler about catching baby hedgehogs
notes.notes:
In the game Prickle you play as a hedgehog dad trying to collect all your children, as they've done a bit of a runner so you need to stick them all together and get them back home.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/06/prickle-is-a-wholesome-sokoban-style-puzzler-about-catching-baby-hedgehogs

notes.notes:

[b]🦔 Featuring Shaked Lotan from Sunbird Studio 🦔[/b]
Join us for an exclusive live stream event during Steam Next Fest, featuring Shaked Lotan, music composer, sound designer, level designer and programmer for Prickle, as he plays the newly released demo for Prickle and talk about the development process.

[b]What to Expect:[/b]
- [b]Gameplay Showcase:[/b] Watch Shaked play the newly released demo of Prickle. See the mechanics and features that make Prickle stand out.
- [b]Deep Dive into Prickle:[/b] Get an inside look at Prickle, a wholesome and challenging puzzle game about hedgehogs. Shaked will walk you through the game’s development process, sharing insights and behind-the-scenes stories.
- [b]Live Q&A:[/b] Have your questions answered live! Shaked will be happy to answer any questions from the audience, providing you with the opportunity to learn more about the development process and challenges behind Prickle.
- [b]Secrets and Future Plans:[/b] Shaked will share some secrets from the development process and discuss future plans for Sunbird. You might even get a sneak peek of the in-development full version!

We can’t wait to see you there!

notes.title: Prickle Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759760?utm_source=steam_news][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876414/f4897bbded3926c68aad7b6adda939c916a978da.png[/img][/url]
[b]🎉 Prickle Demo Now Available! 🎉[/b]

Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for [b]Prickle[/b] is now live on Steam! 🦔

[b]About Prickle:[/b]
Prickle is a wholesome, grid-based, Sokoban-style puzzle game where you help DadHog collect his scattered hoglets. Navigate through over 40 levels across four seasons, each presenting unique challenges and mechanics. Form your Prickle, a Tetris-like shape made up of DadHog and the hoglets, and guide them back home.

[b]What to Expect in the Demo:[/b]
- [b]A Sneak Peek:[/b] Experience the first few levels and get a taste of the charming, wholesome gameplay.
- [b]Unique Mechanics:[/b] Discover how your Prickle grows and evolves as you collect more hoglets, making navigation more challenging and fun.
- [b]Original Soundtrack:[/b] Enjoy the delightful soundtrack that complements the game's atmosphere.

[b]How to Play:[/b]
- [b]Collect Hoglets:[/b] Move DadHog to gather his hoglets, forming a larger Prickle.
- [b]Navigate Challenges:[/b] Find the best path through narrow spaces and tricky puzzles.
- [b]Reach Home:[/b] Bring the entire Prickle back to the home base to complete the level.

We are eager to hear your feedback, so please share your thoughts and experiences with us. Your feedback is crucial to help us improve the game before the full release.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the demo of Prickle!

[b]Download the Demo Now:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759760?utm_source=steam_news]Prickle Demo[/url]

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/TeamSunbird]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ddhMp3CmWR]Discord[/url] for the latest updates and community discussions.

🦔🦔🦔
Happy Prickling!
- Sunbird Studio
